label: first token in {z,x,n,f,c}: <DEL> step and early original inputs i/u/h/m/b/d/p
explanation: Fires almost only before the copy phase (copy-phase share ~0), in sequences whose FIRST original token is z, x, n, f or c (lift 3-7x; z is strongest). About half the mass is on the <DEL> step (rate 5.7x), and those top activations come from short sequences (L 3-5) starting with z. The other half is on original-phase steps t=3-5, mostly first occurrences of the inputs i, u, h, m, b (also d, p). It never fires at t=0-1, is rare after t=5 in the original phase, and is weaker when the sequence has digits. Its strength falls as the sequence gets longer and grows with first token z. Precision is low (about 0.34): many sequences that start with these tokens never activate, so the trigger is graded and not a clean rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=x (+7.25), orig0=z (+7.20), orig0=n (+7.08), t=2 & prev_tok=h (+6.81), orig0=f (+6.69), orig0=c (+6.16). Lower it: phase=2 (-7.24), in_tok=n (-3.76), orig1=h (-3.20), prev3_tok=- (-1.93).
